description:
FRONT AREA
3x Lime(Tilia cordata)-numbered from L-R
T1-smaller tree
-reduce crown by 30%(.5m) to suitable growth points
-remove all epicormic growth to 4m above ground level 
RETAINED HIEGHT-10m
RETAINED SPREAD-3m

Lime(Tilia cordata)
T2-central largest tree
-reduce crown by 30%(3.5m) to suitable growth points
RETAINED HEIGHT-14m
RETAINED SPREAD-3.5m

Lime(Tilia cordata)
T3-RH large tree
-reduce crown by 30%(3.5m) to suitable growth points
-remove all epicormic basal growth to base level 
RETAINED HEIGHT-14m
RETAINED SPREAD-3.5m

REAR GARDEN
T4-T5-2x Cherry(Prunus)-juvenile
-formative prune reducing long stems by up to 1.3m at good growth points

T6-Large Pear(Pyrus)
-light crown reduction by up to 0.6m from tips
-crown thin by 15% denser sections to allow more light through canopy
-remove any deadwood

T7-T8-T9-T10
4x Pear(Pyrus calleyana)
-light prune reducing height by 0.4m
-selective thin of slender inner stems

T11-Southern-blue Gum(Eucalyptus globulis)
-light reduction to shape, balance and tidy

All works are for routine maintenance.
